# kemek-qr

> A free, privacy-first QR code generator. Encoding happens entirely in the visitor's browser — content never touches a server. Eight content types, full visual styling (color, shape, logo, frame), PNG / SVG / PDF export, permalink-encoded settings.

kemek-qr is a free utility published by KeMeK Network. No signup, no expiry, no third-party scripts on generator pages, no individual tracking. The core promise is *client-side generation*: when a visitor types a URL or contact card into the form, that string is encoded into a QR code by JavaScript running locally in the browser — nothing is uploaded, logged, or transmitted to a server. The host (Cloudflare Pages) sees only normal page requests; aggregate pageview counts are visible to KeMeK Network, individual visitors are not.

Source code is MIT licensed. The public repository, which holds the LICENSE text, opens at the v1.0.0 launch. The "KeMeK Network" and "kemek-qr" names and the kemek-qr mark are not covered by the MIT code license; KeMeK Network reserves all rights in them — see [static/brand/USAGE.md](https://qr.kemek.com/brand/USAGE.md) for usage and attribution guidance.

## Tool pages

- [URL QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/): canonical entry. Encodes a web URL into a QR code with visual styling controls and export to PNG / SVG / PDF.
- [Text QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/text): freeform plain-text encoding.
- [Wi-Fi QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/wifi): SSID + password + auth mode in the standard `WIFI:` URI format; scanning joins the network on most modern phones.
- [vCard QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/vcard): contact card (name, organization, phone, email, address, URL) in vCard 3.0 format.
- [Email QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/email): `mailto:` URI with optional subject and body prefill.
- [SMS QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/sms): `sms:` URI with optional message prefill.
- [Phone QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/phone): `tel:` URI for one-tap dialing.
- [Geo QR code generator](https://qr.kemek.com/geo): latitude / longitude coordinates as a `geo:` URI.

## About

- [About kemek-qr](https://qr.kemek.com/about): what the tool is, why it exists, the privacy stance, and the KeMeK Network parent.

## Feature surface

Every generator page exposes the same styling controls:

- Foreground and background colors (independent hex picker)
- Module shape: square, dot, rounded, classy, classy-rounded, extra-rounded
- Eye (finder pattern) shape and color, settable independently of module color
- Logo embedding: upload PNG, JPG, or WebP (up to 4 MB), sized as a fraction of the QR canvas
- Outer frame with a caption label; four font sizes (S / M / L / XL, with XL auto-fitting to label width)
- Error correction level: L / M / Q / H
- Permalink encoding: every setting is captured in the URL hash, so sharing a permalink restores the exact visual configuration on the other end

Export formats: PNG (1024 px raster), SVG (vector), PDF (A4 page, embeds the framed QR as a 2048 px raster).

## Brand and naming

- Publisher: KeMeK Network — https://kemek.com
- License: MIT for code. The names ("kemek-qr", "KeMeK Network") and the QR finder-pattern mark are not covered by the code license; KeMeK Network reserves all rights in them.
- Preferred reference: **"kemek-qr"** (lowercase, hyphenated) or **"kemek-qr by KeMeK Network"**. Not "Kemek QR", "KemekQR", or "Kemek-QR".
